description: This is a unit test class for the CustomerDao component within the OrangeHRM Time plugin, specifically testing CRUD operations and related functionalities for Customer entities.

classes.name: CustomerDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for CustomerDao, testing customer management functions in the OrangeHRM Time plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes CustomerDao and ProjectDao instances before each test.

methods.name: populateCustomerServiceFixture
methods.description: Loads fixture data for customer service tests from YAML file.

methods.name: populateCustomerDaoFixture
methods.description: Loads fixture data for customer DAO tests from YAML file.

methods.name: testAddCustomer
methods.description: Tests adding a new Customer entity and verifies the object and its attributes.

methods.name: testGetCustomerList
methods.description: Verifies that searching for customers returns a list of Customer objects.

methods.name: testGetCustomerById
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by ID and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testGetCustomerByIdOnNull
methods.description: Checks behavior when retrieving a non-existent customer by ID.

methods.name: testGetCustomer
methods.description: Tests retrieving a customer with an ID that does not exist.

methods.name: testUpdateCustomer
methods.description: Tests updating customer details and verifies the changes.

methods.name: testDeleteCustomer
methods.description: Tests deleting customers and confirms project count after deletion.

methods.name: testGetCustomerIdList
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of customer ID lists with and without added entries.

methods.name: testGetCustomerIdListForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Tests retrieving customer IDs for project admin, with various user IDs and options.

methods.name: testExceptionForDeleteCustomer
methods.description: Ensures that deleting a customer with certain parameters throws a CustomerServiceException.

methods.name: testUnselectableCustomerIds
methods.description: Checks the retrieval of IDs that are unselectable.
